blurb: KeyZ Charters operates from Islamorada, providing private boat tours that explore coral reefs, sandbars, mangroves, and wildlife habitats in the Florida Keys. They offer customizable experiences including snorkeling, eco-tours, sunset cruises, historic island visits, and sandbar excursions. Their captains are USCG-licensed and knowledgeable about local waters, focusing on safety, comfort, and environmental care.
